source: 2026-10-03 live run through the BUILT @gullabs/xai adapter (createClient + xaiProvider, transport.fetch teeing the response body): the raw server-sent-event text of real xAI Responses streams, one per feature class. grok-4.5 at effort low (grok-4.7 for the function-call pair and the multi-search run, effort low and medium), Node 24 default fetch, no custom undici Agent. Synthetic prompts only.
sanitization: Nothing edited except: `encrypted_content` blobs are replaced by a deterministic `enc_<sha256-prefix>` placeholder (opaque provider data), and no request header (Authorization) is stored. Request bodies are what the adapter sent. Event bodies, ids, sequence numbers, usage and `cost_in_usd_ticks` are verbatim.
findings: Every item event and delta carries an integer `output_index`; `response.output_item.done` items equal `response.completed.response.output[output_index]` field for field, except `web_search_call.action.sources`, which the final object reports cumulatively for the whole run (multi-search stream).

A function call streams `output_item.added` (arguments ""), one `response.function_call_arguments.delta` carrying the whole argument string, `.done`, then `output_item.done`. An x_search call streams as a `custom_tool_call` with `response.custom_tool_call_input.delta/.done` and an `input` string.

`response.incomplete` (max_output_tokens) arrives with NO `output_item.done`, `output_text.done` or `content_part.done`: the message exists only as `added` + deltas and in the terminal response (status incomplete).
`response.created` and `response.in_progress` carry `usage: null` in every capture.

A plain call streamed only a message item (no reasoning item). Strict structured output streamed a reasoning item with a summary, then ONE message item, at effort low and at high (the two-message quirk of fixture 11 did not recur in these two runs).
